name: urban_rain
observation: Rain changes sky and surfaces; diffuse tone mapping reduces the measured facade sun/shadow ratio from 1.338 to 1.202 while retaining masonry detail.

name: mountain_fog
observation: Fog attenuates distant terrain through the depth-conditioned generation matte while foreground geometry is retained.

name: coastal_snow
observation: Mountain-labeled islands and lighthouse-base rock receive accumulation; the sea remains liquid and invented foreground geometry is rejected.
